finding.title: Incremental backups run every other day and every day
finding.wrong_outcome: an implementer who follows the stated text as written builds a scheduler that runs an incremental backup on Monday, skips Tuesday (`An incremental backup runs every other day at 01:00 UTC.`, S:5) and runs on Tuesday as well (`Incremental backups run every day at 01:00 UTC.`, S:25). Tuesday's job must run and not run, so the schedule test cannot pass.

e1.text: An incremental backup runs every other day at 01:00 UTC.
e1.context:
## 1. Schedule
R1. A full backup runs every Sunday at 01:00 UTC.
R2. An incremental backup runs every other day at 01:00 UTC.
R3. A backup job that is still running when the next one is due makes the next one wait until it finishes.

## 2. Storage

e2.text: Incremental backups run every day at 01:00 UTC.
e2.context:
## 5. Restore
R12. A restore overwrites the production database with the selected backup after one confirmation click.
R13. The confirmation click is the only check before a restore starts.
R14. Incremental backups run every day at 01:00 UTC.

## 6. Notes
The production database is a single primary with one standby. Backups are taken from the standby so that the primary is not slowed down.
